{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cake|Cake]]

'''Honey gingerbread''' is a simple and easy to prepare cookie. It may be decorated if desired.

== Ingredients ==

=== Cookies ===
*500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:All-purpose flour|all-purpose flour]]
*125 g [[cookbook:butter|butter]]
*190 g [[cookbook:Powdered Sugar|powdered sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[cookbook:honey|honey]]
*3 [[cookbook:egg|eggs]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:cinnamon|cinnamon]]
*1 teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]
*4 [[Cookbook:clove|clove]]

=== Decoration ===
*1 [[cookbook:Egg White|egg white]]
*150 g or more powdered sugar

== Procedure ==

=== Cookies ===
#Combine all ingredients in a bowl except 1 egg, and mix until a smooth [[Cookbook:Dough|dough]] is obtained.
#Put the last egg in a cup or small bowl and beat it.
#Divide the dough into 5–6 portions. Take one portion and [[Cookbook:Dough#Rolling|roll it out]] about 3 mm thick.
#Use [[Cookbook:Cookie Cutter|cookie cutters]] to cut out shapes. Transfer cookies to a [[Cookbook:Parchment Paper|parchment]]-lined [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]].
#When the baking sheet is full, use the beaten egg to glaze the cookies.
#[[cookbook:Baking|Bake]] at 180°C for a few minutes, until the cookies are light brown.
#Repeat with the remaining dough.

=== Decoration ===
#Mix the egg white and sugar to make an icing. You may need to add more sugar if the mixture is not firm enough.
#Place the icing in a [[Cookbook:Pastry Bag|piping bag]] or other plastic bag. Cut a small hole (~1 mm) in the tip.
#Squeeze the bag to pipe out the icing and decorate the cookies.
